The challenge

Making last-mile performance predictable

Parcel operators have spent the last decade optimising sorting centres, route planning, tracking and customer visibility. One critical part of the delivery process has been left largely to individual experience: what happens inside and around the delivery vehicle. As volumes grow and experienced drivers become harder to find, predictable performance has become one of the industry's greatest challenges.

PARCELLOC makes this final step predictable. By combining route information, parcel data and vehicle configuration, it determines the optimal position for every parcel and intuitively guides drivers during loading and delivery - running on the scanning and planning infrastructure operators already have.

Instead of asking operators to redesign established workflows, PARCELLOC strengthens the processes they already trust. It augments drivers rather than replacing them, reducing cognitive workload and improving consistency: 30-40% more efficient loading and delivery on a normal day, and extreme volumes on a peak day handled as efficiently as a normal day runs today.

Delivered as a per-vehicle subscription, savings reach up to 9 times the subscription cost - a more predictable, scalable and resilient last-mile operation, and the digital operational foundation for tomorrow.

Why PARCELLOC

Three reasons for operators to choose PARCELLOC

One system for every day: easy, normal, peak

On an easy day, any driver matches your most experienced one. On a normal day, loading and delivery are 30-40% more efficient than that driver. On a peak day, extreme volumes run as smoothly as a normal day does today.

Designed for adoption: new intelligence on existing infrastructure

PARCELLOC applies optimisation inside the vehicle, not only upstream in the network, using the scanning, planning and vehicle data operators already generate. No new scanning ecosystem is required, keeping operational change and implementation risk low. Deployment can start with one vehicle.

Built to scale, designed for the future of last-mile

PARCELLOC optimises loading and parcel retrieval today, and scales seamlessly with any operation. Modular by design, the same foundation extends to new operational models, diverse vehicle concepts and future technologies as parcel delivery continues to change.

Testing & validation

Validated with the people who do the work

PARCELLOC has been tested at proof-of-concept level. A laboratory demonstrator and a vehicle demonstrator were used to evaluate usability, loading efficiency and integration with existing delivery workflows, benchmarked against current loading and delivery practices with a leading European postal operator. Efficiency gains of 30-40% were shown; simulation models across vehicle configurations and operational scenarios indicate a fleet reduction potential of around 10%.

The concept is supported by professionals from leading parcel delivery organisations. A VLAIO-funded Proof-of-Business programme, running since March 2026, is validating commercial applicability across multiple European parcel operators - the structured step between proof-of-concept and live deployment.

Contact

Shape the next generation of last-mile operations

PARCELLOC is looking for progressive postal and parcel operators willing to run a structured test on a limited set of routes. PARCELLOC works from the scan and planning data you already produce, requires no change to your route-planning system, and is fitted to a small number of vehicles for the duration of the test.

In return, you get a measured comparison against your current loading and delivery practice - on your own routes and volumes - and direct influence on the modular configuration that fits your operation. We also welcome strategic technology partners and investors who share our vision of making last-mile delivery more predictable, scalable and driver-friendly.
